title: 第25章 双龙出山搅动江湖第26章 聚贤庄双龙初显
lines: “小鱼儿师兄，话说你的燕伯伯被师父挤出地榜，你难道就不生气吗？”
韦小宝人小鬼大，见到有瓜吃，肯定要添一把火。
小鱼儿也是人精，自然不会中了韦小宝的奸计。
“燕伯伯已经失踪十几年了，十几年战绩毫无更新，能霸榜这么久实属难得。就算没师父跻身，也会被其他人挤下去。”
“更何况以师父的实力，在地榜也待不了很久，接下来肯定是要冲击天榜。”
算一算，双龙现在都被传授了功夫，师父也应允他们一个月后下山。
那么按照入门时间来算，下一个就该是自己了。
小鱼儿知道了身世和真相，现在无比期待学成下山，见一见自己的亲兄弟花无缺。
当然，在相认之前，肯定是要好好和花无缺打一场，把他打到鼻青脸肿再告诉他真相。
除了江寒跻身地榜的消息，江寒还在半月谈看到了新消息。
郭靖来回奔波，到后金王庭找杨过对峙，结果被杨过和西毒欧阳锋联手击退，带伤逃走。
江寒没想到杨过和欧阳锋联起手来，不过有欧阳锋从旁照应，杨过在后金的处境应该会好很多。
看到杨过的消息，江寒系统再次出现提示。
【杨过的命运发生改变，改命点+100】
除了有关杨过的消息，江寒也看到了不少新的江湖消息。
萧秋水当日在祝寿后离开，前往川蜀寻找自己破碎的记忆。
最终在一家包子店找到了挚爱唐方。
萧秋水散尽身上的三百年功力和忘情天书，找回了全部记忆，选择和唐方度过人生最后的时间。
一代天骄萧秋水，正式下线。
当江寒看完这个消息，不由感慨万千。
昔日萧秋水因缘际会学会忘情天书，学得顶级武功的同时，也忘记了挚爱。
一晃几十年，为国为民，也为正道江湖出力许多。
现在重新找回记忆，在人生最后阶段卸下一切的期待和重担，只为自己而活。
现在，因为萧秋水散功隐退，天榜空出一个名额。
于是江湖人士的目光也集中在那些有资格进入天榜，填补萧秋水空缺的人身上。
半月谈甚至还列出了几名候选者。
第一位，岭南宋缺，人称天刀。
岭南宋阀阀主，武功、兵法双绝的一代宗师，天下前三的刀手。
常年在磨刀堂闭关，据传已钻研出天刀之上的招式，晋升超绝。
第二位，北宋诸葛神侯。
四位弟子出类拔萃，是江湖上的豪杰正义之士。
而诸葛神侯本人，武林之贤，皇上之友；文林之仙，侠道之师。
一身武艺超神入化，惊艳一枪更是当世两大枪中神技。
第三位，慈航静斋当代斋主言静庵，所修慈航剑典，至“剑心通明”境界。
剑典剑法已是绝代剑客水准，亦是白道武林一大势力，甚至足以影响到江湖及王朝兴衰格局。也曾于黑榜决定，魔师庞斑有过一段羁绊，并要求庞斑隐退江湖二十年。
这三位候选者，将会是天榜空缺位置的最有利争夺者。
等看完了这一期的半月谈，双龙、小鱼儿和韦小宝就开始起哄。
“师父，你也别经常待在山上啊！你再下山刷几个战绩，就是天榜的有力争夺者了。”
江寒给几人一人一个脑壳丁，笑骂道：“你们这是看热闹不嫌事大，是巴不得为师早点去死是吧？”
在山上的这一个月。
双龙每天勤加苦练，每天都交手拆招。
一个对内力的掌控更加精妙，另一个对招式技巧愈发纯熟。
同时，这段时间内，坐不住的小鱼儿、韦小宝以及张无忌三人，还在终南山里一番探索，意外结识了古墓派的孙婆婆。
小鱼儿和韦小宝人小鬼大，张无忌忠厚老实，三个孩子的性格，完全拿捏了孙婆婆。
content_en:
"Senior Brother Xiao Yu'er, aren't you angry that your Uncle Yan was kicked out of the ranking list by Master?"
Wei Xiaobao is a brat, and when he sees something to eat, he will definitely add fuel to the fire.
Xiao Yu'er is also a human spirit, so naturally she won't fall into Wei Xiaobao's tricks.
"Uncle Yan has been missing for more than ten years, and his record has not been updated for more than ten years. It is really rare to be able to dominate the rankings for so long. Even if Master does not make it, he will be pushed down by others."
"What's more, with Master's strength, he won't be able to stay on the Earth Ranking for long. He will definitely hit the Heaven Ranking next."
Doing the math, both dragons have now been taught kung fu, and the master has promised them to go down the mountain in a month.
So based on the entry time, I should be the next one.
Xiao Yu'er knows her life experience and the truth, and now she is looking forward to going down the mountain after completing her studies and meeting her brother Hua Wuque.
Of course, before we recognize each other, we must have a good fight with Hua Wuque, beat him until his nose is bruised and his face is swollen, and then tell him the truth.
In addition to the news that Jiang Han has made it to the top list, Jiang Han also saw new news in Banyuetan.
Guo Jing ran back and forth and confronted Yang Guo at Houjin Palace. However, he was repelled by Yang Guo and Xidu Ouyang Feng, and escaped with injuries.
Jiang Han didn't expect Yang Guo and Ouyang Feng to join forces, but with Ouyang Feng taking care of him, Yang Guo's situation in Houjin should be much better.
After seeing Yang Guo's news, Jiang Han's system prompted another prompt.
[Yang Guo’s fate has changed, changed fate points +100]
In addition to the news about Yang Guo, Jiang Han also saw a lot of new news about the world.
Xiao Qiushui left after celebrating his birthday that day and went to Sichuan to search for his broken memories.
Finally, I found my beloved Tang Fang in a steamed stuffed bun shop.
Xiao Qiushui used up his three hundred years of skill and the Book of Forgetfulness, recovered all his memories, and chose to spend the last time of his life with Tang Fang.
Xiao Qiushui, the genius of a generation, is officially offline.
When Jiang Han read the news, he couldn't help but be filled with emotion.
In the past, Xiao Qiushui learned the Heavenly Book of Forgetting Love by fate. While he learned top-notch martial arts, he also forgot his true love.
Fast forward a few decades, and he has made a lot of contributions to the country, the people, and the righteous world.
Now rediscover memories, let go of all expectations and burdens in the last stage of life, and live only for yourself.
Now, because Xiao Qiushui has retired from San Gong, there is an empty spot on the Heavenly Ranking.
Therefore, the eyes of people in the world are also focused on those who are qualified to enter the Tianban and fill Xiao Qiushui's vacancy.
Banyuetaan even listed several candidates.
The first one is Lingnan Song Que, known as the Heavenly Sword.
The leader of the Lingnan Song Dynasty, a master of martial arts and military tactics, and one of the top three swordsmen in the world.
He has been in seclusion in Mo Dao Hall all year round. It is said that he has mastered moves above the Heavenly Sword and has been promoted to the highest level.
The second place is Zhuge Shenhou of the Northern Song Dynasty.
The four disciples are outstanding and are heroes and righteous men in the world.
Zhuge Shenhou himself is a sage in martial arts and a friend of the emperor; an immortal in literary circles and a master of chivalry.
His martial arts skills are superb, and his stunning spear is one of the two greatest spear skills in the world.
The third place is Yan Jing'an, the contemporary master of Cihang Jingzhai, who has cultivated the Cihang Sword Canon to the point where "the heart of the sword is clear".
Jian Dian's swordsmanship is already at the level of an unparalleled swordsman, and he is also a major force in the Baidao martial arts world, which can even affect the rise and fall of the world and dynasties. It was also decided in the black list that the magician Pang Ban had a bond and asked Pang Ban to retire from the world for twenty years.
These three candidates will be the most favorable contenders for the vacant positions on the Tianlist.
After finishing reading this issue of Ban Yue Tan, Shuanglong, Xiao Yu'er and Wei Xiaobao started to make noises.
"Master, don't stay on the mountain too often! If you go down the mountain and gain a few more records, you will be a strong contender for the Heavenly Ranking."
Jiang Han gave each of them a skull and scolded them with a smile: "You are just watching the fun and don't think it's a big deal. You just want your master to die early, right?"
This month in the mountains.
Shuangyong practices hard every day and fights against each other every day.
One has more subtle control over his inner strength, and the other has become more proficient in his moves.
At the same time, during this period of time, Xiao Yu'er, Wei Xiaobao and Zhang Wuji, who could not sit still, were still exploring the Zhongnan Mountains and unexpectedly met Granny Sun of the Ancient Tomb Sect.
Xiao Yu'er and Wei Xiaobao are big and small, Zhang Wuji is loyal and honest, and the three children's personalities completely caught up with Grandma Sun.
